original_multinational: Only historical train-role systems active; all historical validation/test arrays protected and unopened. Old train systems split chronologically: targets before2018 for training, full histories from2018 onward for validation.
existing_japanese: Keep previous development2022–2023 as training, previous validation2024 as validation. Previously evaluated internal holdout2025–2026 is protected: no training or new untouched-test claim.
interval_policy: Use exact entire maximum-history-to-observed-target intervals. Each interval must lie inside one assigned chronological partition; pairwise partition interval-intersection checks. No fixed31day shortcut, no random rows.
observed_targets: All actual future acquisitions with0<h<=60 for every eligible origin, not fixed horizon classes; no interpolation as truth.

learned_stage1.type: resolution-aware per-pixel Ridge predicting change, explicit continuous horizon and horizon-scaled physical features; no volcano IDs

stage1_selection: Validation system-macro MAE on all actual horizons, within1% prefer lower extreme-change MAE then shorter history then model ID. Freeze before newly acquired internal/geographic evaluation. Report exact and binned horizon composition, not separate classes.
uncertainty: Training-only map-balanced90% residual bands per horizon bin, minimum20maps; honest empirical calibration without physical-noise or exchangeability guarantee. Optional horizon-dependent proxy is not calibrated noise.

events.primary: JMA-explicit Ex explosion, including another explosion during ongoing eruption
events.negative_policy: Only complete verified catalogue windows; unknown or future uncovered periods censored

stage2_design: Assess independent event counts, chronology and overlap, not just many origin/horizon rows. Strict as-of and explicitly retrospective scientific populations reported separately; no automatic bypass of prior gates. Stage2 training needs>=20 reachable episodes with>=5 independently grouped episodes in validation and>=5 in a subsequent held-out period, known negative exposure and real monitoring overlap. Geographic transfer only if independent positive systems support it.
forbidden: Reserved Peru data or any new foreign-country final test; modifying previous artifacts; future observed deformation/event labels/quality as predictors; identity lookup; holdout tuning.
api: Dynamically compute new predictions from validated supplied arrays/timestamps/grid/LOS/reference metadata. No required volcano ID. Arbitrary1–60day queries, explicit evidence/shift statuses. Stage2 unavailable if no eligible trained model. No stored forecast lookup.
retrospective: All inherited InSAR has full-record retrospective processing; distinguish scientific performance from operational as-of validity. Missing monitoring publication times never imply real-time availability.
